name: Harper Anderson
why: A sharp, well lit head-and-shoulders portrait of her alone against a brick wall, published by WKU itself. The only Herald photograph of her has her face buried in someone's shoulder, so this is far and away the best frame of her in any WKU source.
caption_quote: Harper Anderson, Outstanding Major in Criminology
identification: The page is about her and nobody else, it carries exactly one photograph, and its heading prints her name. The text beneath is her own first-person statement and names the office outright: 'During my time at WKU, I have become involved as a Spirit Master, Academic Excellence Chair of Kappa Delta Sorority, President of Pi Alpha Delta Pre-Law Society, Administrative Vice President of Student Government Association'. Cross-checked against a second WKU page, the Political Science department's student card at /political-science/harperandersonprofile.php, which prints 'Harper Anderson, Major: Political Science | Class of 2021, Morehead, KY' beside a full-length photograph of the same woman.

src.label: WKU Department of Sociology and Criminology, student award page 'Harper Anderson, Outstanding Criminology Major'

also_seen: WKU Political Science student profile card, https://www.wku.edu/political-science/harperandersonprofile.php

name: Antonina Clementi
quality: small: cropped out of an eight-person group photograph, so her head is about a hundred pixels across, and the top of the hair of the woman standing in front of her clips the bottom left corner. Not upscaled.
why: The only unmasked, face-forward photograph of her in any WKU source. Both Herald frames that name her are unusable: in one her head is above the top of the picture, and the other is a twenty-six person award photograph in which everybody is wearing a mask.
caption_quote: 2022 Lincoln-Douglas debate students: Miles Morton, Antonina Clemente, Andre Swai, Imam Brula; (front) Tanya Prabhakar, Madelynn Einhorn, Tess Welch, Avery Linehan
identification: A positioned list, and the rows genuinely line up: eight people in two unambiguous tiers of four, four standing on the step behind and four in front, with no stagger between them. Reading the back tier left to right gives Morton, Clementi, Swai, Brula, so she is the second figure, the woman in glasses and a maroon floral dress. The front tier reads Prabhakar, Einhorn, Welch, Linehan across four clearly separated figures, which is the check that the caption's order is left to right. WKU spells the surname Clemente in this one caption and Clementi in the team lists on the same page. Consistent with the Herald's photograph of her of 24 January 2023, where the figure the caption places at left has the same long dark hair.

src.label: WKU Forensics, team history archive 2020-29, sample photograph for the 2021-22 season

also_seen: The page carrying it is https://www.wku.edu/forensics/history/archive-2020-29.php, where the caption is the image title attribute.
